raw_output: Jimmy's approaches to managing his mental health have evolved over time. Initially, he struggled with feelings of guilt and shame after a relapse, but he found support in his AA friends, particularly Bob, who encouraged him to focus on progress rather than perfection. Jimmy began to recognize patterns of avoidance and started journaling to untangle his emotions. He discovered a pattern of avoiding uncomfortable conversations and realized he had been doing this a lot. Through journaling, Jimmy gained clarity and began to forgive himself, learning to be gentler with himself and accepting that it's okay to not have everything figured out. He started to take steps towards reconnecting with friends, like George, and considered seeking professional guidance through therapy.
